sloka: शोभयिष्यन्ति काकुत्स्थम् अटव्यो रम्य काननाः ।आपगाः च महा अनूपाः सानुमन्तः च पर्वताः ॥२-४८-१०॥
transliteration: śobhayiṣyanti kākutstham aṭavyo ramya kānanāḥ ।āpagāḥ ca mahā anūpāḥ sānumantaḥ ca parvatāḥ ॥2-48-10॥

translations.english: Forests with beautiful groves rivers with vast expanse of waters, mountains with their slopes will enhance the lustre of the scion of the Kakutsthas (Rama).
